body:
Wrote a technical blog post draft for r/proceduralgeneration about NOCK's procedural texture generator, focused on the founder-identified angle: using PARENA's Java emitter (zero I/O surface, five math primitives, single-expression function bodies, no #target/inline escape hatch) as a compile-time sandbox instead of the C target's real, unrestricted inline-C RCE vector. Every technical claim (math primitive list, single-expression scope, absence of #target handling) verified directly against PARENA/src/emit_java.c/.h and emit.c rather than written from memory. Saved to IDUNA/docs/NOCK_PROCGEN_REDDIT_POST.md. Draft only -- founder posts it to Reddit themselves.

⚓ ☃
title: Reddit blog post draft: NOCK's PARENA-to-JVM compiler sandboxing (r/proceduralgeneration)
